rules.notes: General garlic N nutrient requirement 70-125 kg N/ha, NOT urea product kg/ha. The manual does not provide a mapping from field conditions to a precise value within this interval. The first half is applied as crop growth begins; remaining half is split into 2-3 later applications spaced three weeks. Do not apply when bulbing begins (separate advisory). REVIEW: 70-125 kg N/ha nutrient (not urea); schedule accurate. Soil, prior crop, organic matter and climate are variability factors, NOT quantified thresholds.

other.variation: depends on soil type, previous crop, organic matter, climate

rules.timing: One-half as soon as the crop begins to grow; remainder split into two to three applications at three-week intervals

evidence.source_text: Garlic will generally require 70-125 kg N per hectare and one-half of it should be applied as soon as the crop begins to grow; the remainder should be split into two to three applications at three-week intervals.
Fertilizer requirements of garlic crop vary with fertility status of the soil, availability of soil moisture, variety of the crop, purpose for which the crop is grown, etc.
The total amount of N required for crops vary with the soil type, the previous crop grown, and the amount of organic matter present in the soil and the climatic conditions during the growing season.
